list.item: Weight loss to a body mass index of 16.0 (47.4 kg at 172 cm), about 6 kg over six months, with fatigue, swelling of both ankles, dizziness on standing, slow pulse and cold intolerance; cause not established at intake; a restrictive eating disorder suspected, with thyroid disease, celiac disease, diabetes, malignancy and adrenal insufficiency to be excluded; eating disorders psychiatry consultation requested: active, confirmed [S]
Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate, with persistent grief for her son, who died five years ago; passive thoughts of death without intent or plan at intake: active, confirmed [S]

Eating disorders psychiatry consultation in one week to confirm the diagnosis, decide the level of care, and lead a multidisciplinary plan. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Eating Disorders, Fourth Edition (2023); Eating Disorders: A Guide to Medical Care (AED Medical Care Standards Guide), 4th edition (2021) [S]

Medical assessment and stabilization: orthostatic vital signs and temperature, ECG, blood count, electrolytes with phosphate and magnesium, glucose, kidney and liver tests, albumin, TSH, CRP, ferritin and vitamin D; admission criteria explained; electrolytes, phosphate and magnesium to be rechecked three to four days after the meal plan starts, then weekly for the first weeks. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Eating Disorders, Fourth Edition (2023); Medical Management of Restrictive Eating Disorders in Adolescents and Young Adults (position paper) (2022); Eating Disorders: A Guide to Medical Care (AED Medical Care Standards Guide), 4th edition (2021) [S]

Refeeding risk: thiamine 100 mg daily before and during the first two weeks, and a starting meal plan of about 1,600 kcal a day in three meals and two snacks, increased by about 200 to 300 kcal every few days. Guideline: Medical Management of Restrictive Eating Disorders in Adolescents and Young Adults (position paper) (2022); ASPEN Consensus Recommendations for Refeeding Syndrome (2020) [S]

Collaborative safety plan with warning signs, coping steps, people to contact including her travelling companion, the clinic number, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and local emergency numbers abroad; medicines dispensed in small supplies and kept by her companion. Guideline: VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024) [S]

Privacy: the chart is flagged as restricted, access is audited, she is booked under a scheduling alias at the first or last appointment of the day, and weights are discussed only in the consulting room. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Eating Disorders, Fourth Edition (2023) [S]
